title: Test plan · Week 1 · v1
sub: 3 tests, $77 test budget for the week
headline: Focus week 1 on fixing Ad 1 fatigue where CTR fell 61.7% at frequency 7.1 [ev-d7-ad_1-ctr] and 3-day cost hit $8.70 vs $4 target [ev-d7-ad_1-cpr3] while building on Test 1 winner at $2.40 per trial on $100.94 spend for 42 results [ev-d7-test_1-readout] and $2.4 vs $4 [ev-w1-ad_4-week]. Two fix tests refresh Ad 1 in cmp_1; one exploratory tests low-pressure free start in cmp_2.

content.summary: Focus week 1 on fixing Ad 1 fatigue where CTR fell 61.7% at frequency 7.1 [ev-d7-ad_1-ctr] and 3-day cost hit $8.70 vs $4 target [ev-d7-ad_1-cpr3] while building on Test 1 winner at $2.40 per trial on $100.94 spend for 42 results [ev-d7-test_1-readout] and $2.4 vs $4 [ev-w1-ad_4-week]. Two fix tests refresh Ad 1 in cmp_1; one exploratory tests low-pressure free start in cmp_2.

tests.name: Ad1 Fatigue Refresh - Tiny-Space Phone
tests.hypothesis: Replacing the tired Streak creative with a fresh phone photo showing a tiny-space no-gear workout will lift click rate and move cost per trial back toward $4 in broad.
tests.stop_rule: Review after 4 days or about $50 spend; pause if CTR stays down vs Ad 1 and 3-day cost per trial remains above $4.

brief.hook: 10 minutes, no gear, just your living-room floor.
brief.key_message: Phone shows your 10-minute bodyweight workout that fits a small floor space, no gear needed.

tests.name: Streak Keeper - Fresh Phone Visual
tests.hypothesis: A fresh phone visual that encourages keeping the streak with a simple weekly plan will lower Ad 1 high cost per trial.
tests.stop_rule: Review after 4 days; stop if 3-day cost per trial stays above $4.

brief.hook: Three days in a row - keep your streak going?
brief.key_message: Phone reminds you to keep your streak with a clear 10-minute plan for this week.

tests.name: Low-Pressure Free Start Exploratory
tests.hypothesis: A new low-pressure free-start angle in the winning social-proof campaign will attract hesitant triers and hold cost at or below $4.
tests.stop_rule: Review after 5 days; stop if cost per trial exceeds $4 and trails Test 1 winner.

brief.hook: Try 7 days free and see what fits your mornings.
brief.key_message: Start free on your phone with a low-pressure 10-minute plan to try at home.
